about: Thirty moments for the held-out router test, 2026-09-23. Verbs are the game's own catalogue (IntentBridge, CoreTests, RouterFloor); cast and places from canon.md; the content rule (D18) holds: no drink, betting or children. Each moment is what the router would be told: who the player speaks to, the scene, the verbs on offer with their closed arguments, and the people it knows by name.
